narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic short video explores the identity shift of a long-term expatriate. The Japanese protagonist complains about high tourist prices in Taiwan with the mindset of a local, only to be comically reminded that he is technically still a foreigner himself. The contrast between his local behaviors and his actual nationality provides the humorous core.
